svg.text: EVERY STEP IN ORDER — NO SUBSTITUTION
VC-101 base + VC-102 lid. Posts integral. Fill port drilled + counterbored.
Vapour degrease → 10% H2SO4 pickle 60 s → DI rinse → N2 blow dry.
Cu powder 45-75 um. 950 C / 30 min / H2 or vacuum. Mask rim, post tops, fill bore.
Stack lid on base. 850 C / 8 MPa / 60 min / vacuum < 1e-3 Pa.
Laser or micro-TIG weld Cu tube OD3.0 to lid. No filler, no flux.
He mass spec, chamber under vacuum. Reject > 1e-9 Pa.m3/s.
200 C / 4 h / < 1e-3 Pa through the fill tube. Pump throughout.
1.90 mL DI water 18 MOhm.cm, deaerated. Burette under vacuum, chamber at 0 C.
Freeze-pump-thaw x 3. Final pump at ice point to < 10 Pa.
Cold-weld the tube in a hydraulic pincher. Laser-seal the tip. Trim + fold.
He bomb 3 bar / 4 h, then mass spec. Reject > 1e-9 Pa.m3/s.
3 thermal cycles 20 ↔ 100 C. Re-test R th after.
R th (case-to-case) < 0.25 K/W at 50 W, horizontal and vertical.
Charging before diffusion bonding. Water boils at 100 C and the bond runs at 850 C: the chamber ruptures. This error appears on the superseded Maxsorb drawing — do not repeat it.
Threaded or O-ring fill seals. A screw seal cannot hold high vacuum; helium ingress accumulates as non-condensable gas and the condenser is blanketed within months. Cold-weld
Aluminium anywhere wetted. Al + water generates H2. The fin stack is external and TIM-coupled only.
Undeaerated water. Dissolved O2 oxidises copper and liberates H2.
Tough-pitch copper (C11000 / JIS C1100) or brass/bronze anywhere in the envelope. Oxygen-bearing copper cracks in the hydrogen sinter; Zn and Sn evaporate under vacuum at bond
Activated carbon or any organic inside the envelope without a 250 C / 8 h vacuum bake.
Non-condensable gas is the dominant failure mode of a sealed two-phase device.
Steps 7, 9 and 10 exist solely to prevent it. None of them is optional.
Charge by MASS, not by volume: 1.90 mL DI water = 1.87 g at 20 C. A burette
reading is not traceable once the chamber is cold and under vacuum.
